title: Skala — Legal Platform for Startups
description: Incorporate globally, manage fundraising, corporate services, and more.
summary: Incorporate globally, manage fundraising, corporate services, and more.
offersHint: Incorporate globally, manage fundraising, corporate services, and more. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://ai.skala.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_useful_resources
toolsPreview.description: Get a list of useful resources: guides, references, and instructional materials for legal topics and Skala platform usage.

toolsPreview.name: get_available_doc_gens
toolsPreview.description: Get the list of legal document templates available for generation on the platform (e.g. NDA, employment agreement, stock purchase agreement). For corporate services like 83(b) filing or registered agent, use get_available_corporate_services instead.

toolsPreview.name: get_available_corporate_services
toolsPreview.description: Get corporate services available on the platform — including DBA, name changes, filings, compliance, registered agent, and other company-related services. Always check this when the user asks about any service for their company.

toolsPreview.name: get_available_companies_for_registration
toolsPreview.description: Get the list of company types available for registration on the platform.

toolsPreview.name: get_users_companies
toolsPreview.description: Get the user's companies on the platform.

toolsPreview.name: get_company_info_by_id
toolsPreview.description: Get information about the user's company by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_users_tasks_and_deadlines
toolsPreview.description: Get the list of user's tasks and deadlines.

toolsPreview.name: submit_support_request
toolsPreview.description: Submit a support request to the Skala team on behalf of the user. Call this when the user needs human assistance that AI cannot provide, the question is too complex or high-risk, or the user explicitly asks for human support. IMPORTANT: Always confirm with the user before calling — describe what you will submit and ask for their approval. Before calling, compile the issue from conversation context into the description.
